mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (id, user_id, order_no, total_amount, status, expire_time, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{orderNo}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, payment_time = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expire_time < NOW()
